macros.name: dncurrent
macros.doc: Stores the current dn list used in the |\dnget| command.

macros.name: dndeclare
macros.doc: The \dndeclare macro defines a list name and defines a pgfkey that stores all symbolic links and their values.

macros.name: dnget
macros.doc: Get the value stored in a specific dn list entry.
